findings.highlight: I reach out to her with my hand
findings.evidenceJa: 身を乗り出してセイバーに手を伸ばす
findings.governingReading: I lean my body out and reach for Saber
findings.explanation: Shirou’s dangerous bodily extension toward Saber is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: それで察してくれたのか
findings.governingReading: Perhaps she understands from that
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inference is promoted, while the surrounding full-speed attempt to disengage from the battlefield becomes merely jumping away.

findings.highlight: jumps away with all her might
findings.evidenceJa: 全速で戦場からの離脱を試みる
findings.governingReading: attempts to withdraw from the battlefield at full speed
findings.explanation: A tactical full-speed disengagement is reduced to an unspecified jump.

findings.evidenceJa: 防ぐまでもないとセイバーに迫る巨人
findings.governingReading: The giant closes on Saber as though the arrow is not even worth blocking
findings.explanation: The continuing pursuit and its rationale become simple disregard.

findings.evidenceJa: 体を震わせる大気の振動
findings.governingReading: the vibration of the air shaking my body
findings.explanation: The blast’s pressure through the air becomes ground movement.

findings.highlight: Many things go flying through the air, and a piece of something pierces my back
findings.evidenceJa: 様々な破片は四方に跳ね飛ばされ
findings.governingReading: all kinds of fragments ricochet in every direction and strike into my back
findings.explanation: A multidirectional shrapnel field and its heavy impacts are reduced to one vague piece.

findings.highlight: a piece of something pierces my back
findings.evidenceJa: ごっ、と重い音をたてて
findings.governingReading: with a heavy thud
findings.explanation: The heavy sound marking the fragment’s impact into Shirou’s back disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 体はなんとか致命傷を受けずに
findings.governingReading: my body somehow weathered it without suffering a fatal wound
findings.explanation: Avoiding a fatal injury becomes the broader and less informative fact of survival.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺の下で、セイバーは呆然とソレを見ていた
findings.governingReading: Beneath me, Saber stares at it in astonishment
findings.explanation: Their physical positions after Shirou pins Saber down are omitted.

findings.highlight: razed this cemetery in an instant
findings.evidenceJa: 墓地が一瞬にして炎上した
findings.governingReading: set the cemetery ablaze in an instant
findings.explanation: The observed ignition becomes total destruction or leveling.

findings.evidenceJa: それほどの破壊を以ってしても、あの巨人は健在だった
findings.governingReading: such destruction
findings.explanation: A semantically inapplicable word produces conspicuously broken English.

findings.evidenceJa: ランクＡに該当する宝具
findings.governingReading: a Noble Phantasm equivalent to Rank A
findings.explanation: Saber’s classification by equivalence becomes an unqualified intrinsic rank.

findings.evidenceJa: カラン、と硬い音をたてて
findings.governingReading: with a hard clatter
findings.explanation: The material quality of the approaching object’s sound is erased.

findings.highlight: it is an “arrow” if it’s used as a projectile
findings.evidenceJa: “矢”として使われたのなら、それは矢だった
findings.governingReading: if it was used as an “arrow,” then it was an arrow
findings.explanation: Shirou’s pointed functional classification is broadened from use specifically as an arrow to any projectile.

findings.highlight: It Makes me feel like vomiting
findings.evidenceJa: 理由もなく、吐き気を呼び起こした
findings.governingReading: It makes me feel like vomiting
findings.explanation: A stray mid-sentence capital visibly breaks the continuation across pages.

findings.evidenceJa: やつは口元を歪めていた
findings.governingReading: his mouth was twisted
findings.explanation: The hostile visual detail Shirou impossibly perceives is normalized into an ordinary smile.

findings.evidenceJa: 背骨が熱くなって吐きそうになる
findings.governingReading: my spine grows hot and I feel ready to vomit
findings.explanation: Half of Shirou’s comparison to failed Magic Circuit formation is omitted.

findings.highlight: starts to retreat through the fire
findings.evidenceJa: 少女の声に応えるかのように後退しだした
findings.governingReading: begins retreating as if in answer to the girl’s voice
findings.explanation: The response relation between Illya’s order and Berserker’s movement disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはいらない
findings.governingReading: I have no need for Saber
findings.explanation: Illya’s dismissive assessment of utility becomes personal desire.

findings.evidenceJa: 白い少女は笑いながら
findings.governingReading: The white girl laughs
findings.explanation: Illya’s identifying visual contrast is omitted, and her departure beyond the flames is reduced to simply going away.

findings.evidenceJa: 大した傷も負っていない
findings.governingReading: I have not suffered any serious wound
findings.explanation: Shirou’s acknowledgement of lesser injuries becomes a claim that he is uninjured.

findings.evidenceJa: ほとんどの機能が落ちてしまった
findings.governingReading: most of my functions shut down
findings.explanation: A broad systemic collapse becomes sensory loss alone.

findings.highlight: What’s left is this throbbing within me
findings.evidenceJa: 残ったのは、この鼓動だけ
findings.governingReading: Only this heartbeat remains
findings.explanation: The one bodily function remaining is made an unidentified throbbing sensation.

findings.evidenceJa: 熱病めいた頭痛だけが、鼓動のように続いていた
findings.governingReading: only the feverish headache continues like a heartbeat
findings.explanation: The fever quality, exclusivity, and comparison linking headache to heartbeat are all removed.
